mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which can stimulate borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following low FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as consumer and business sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods following UNRATE increases, the hypothesis is rejected.
